newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds aim skyward after 113-07 bounce.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds aim skyward after 113-07 bounce.

text.p: U.S. T-bond futures' resilience on Tuesday bodes well and suggests the market will get back on track for an attack on the recent 114-15 high, technical analysts said on Wednesday.
"They did rally very well and I think the strong recovery shows good support," said Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis in London.
"We should go back and have a look at the peak."
At 1030 GMT, September T-bond futures were at 114-01, up 3/32 from the prior close.
Rigg said the market would need to fall back below Tuesday's low of 113-07 to suggest that the recent peak was strong enough resistance to cap T-bonds.
But she added T-bonds were getting close to resistance from a topping area established last November and December. September futures set a 115-17 high on December 3, 1996.
"It's reasonably positive but we've got a lot of figures coming out," she said.
U.S. consumer prices are due at 1230 GMT, followed by industrial production and capacity utilisation at 1315 GMT.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said in a research note T-bonds should range trade between 113-00 and 115-00 for the next week or two.
"We are leaving the short-term direction neutral and putting the medium term back to neutral," they said.
By 1050 GMT, December Eurodollars were up 0.005 at 94.045.
